kicker: THE GYM IS ONLY THE SIGNAL
title: 6 things after the gym that *kill your gains*

items.head: Ice bath after lifting
items.sub: Cold plunges cut muscle gains in a 12-week study. Shower instead.

items.head: Pills for normal soreness
items.sub: Just sore? Take an easy walk instead.

items.head: No record of your lifts
items.sub: Log every set. Beat last week by 5 lb.

items.head: Hard run right after
items.sub: Easy cardio only. Intervals go 6+ hours later.

items.head: 4-hour nights
items.sub: 5 short nights cut muscle building by a fifth.

items.head: 12 drinks after leg day
items.sub: Cut muscle building by a quarter, even with protein.

label: THE CHECK
head: Write down 3 lifts today
sub: Compare in 6 weeks. If the numbers didn't move, neither did the muscle.

text: The pump fades in an hour. *Muscle gets built after you leave.*
